structured_output.what_is_happening: APEZCAT (apeonzcat) is a 38-minute-old pump.fun token that has already migrated to PumpSwap. It is a derivative "crossover" meme that combines two recently hot Solana memecoins: apeonfone ($fone), which briefly hit about $30M market cap in September 2026, and Anonymous Cat ($ZCAT), which pays holders in Zcash and was covered by CoinDesk on Sep 7, 2026. The project's X account (@apeonzcat, 54 followers, 16 tweets) posted "APEONZCAT is live now" at 19:00 UTC. That post had 6 likes and 398 views. I found no organic discussion on X search, Reddit, Telegram or in the news. The same X account and website are also attached to at least one earlier APEZCAT mint from about Sep 9, 2026 (6Jcr2C…), which is now dead at a $2.6K market cap. This mint is at least the fourth APEZCAT launch. The ~$920K of hourly volume on $55K liquidity, 199 bundler wallets holding a 63% top-bundler trader share, and a creator who has already sold out (creator_close) look like a bundled/bot-driven launch pump, not attention coming from a story.

narrative.description: Derivative mashup of two September 2026 Solana meme narratives: apeonfone ("ape on fone") and Anonymous Cat/ZCAT (Zcash-paying cat). The bio reads "fone was temporary. zcat is forever." Nothing new is happening; it rides existing brands.
narrative.why_spreading: Both parent memes are real and were recently hot (fone reached $30M briefly per Odaily; ZCAT paid about $2.8M in ZEC per CoinDesk). A crossover gives low-effort recognition. But the only visible promotion is the project's own tiny account, and the idea has already failed at least three times on earlier mints.

token_connection.why_this_token: It carries the project's X and website links and has a DexScreener profile flagged as a community takeover. It is the only APEZCAT mint with real liquidity right now.
token_connection.competing_tokens: At least 3 earlier APEZCAT/apeonzcat mints from about Sep 9–10, 2026 (6Jcr2C…, ewryMP…, 6tKmvb…) are all dead at about $2.5K market cap. At least one (6Jcr2C…) links to the same apeonzcat.com and @apeonzcat. There is also a newer copy, APECAT GXCs…. The brand has been relaunched repeatedly.

authenticity.evidence: GMGN shows 199 bundler wallets with a 63.3% top-bundler trader share, 49 snipers, 7 smart wallets, 0 renowned/KOL wallets and 0 smart-money signals. The creator has closed their position (0% held), the creator wallet launched 4 tokens, and the dev's X account is linked to 13 launches. Turnover is about 17x liquidity in an hour, with roughly 941 unique buyers doing 8,000+ buys (about 8.5 buys per wallet), which points to bots. The official launch tweet got 398 views and 6 likes. The X account reuse across dead mints suggests a relaunch operator.
authenticity.uncertainty: I can't see X posts directly beyond the fxtwitter API, and private Telegram call groups are invisible. The site apeonzcat.com failed with an SSL error. Some real degen participation clearly exists (about 1,500 holders).

structural_risks: Heavy bundler presence (63% top bundler trader share) that could dump into $55K liquidity
A serial deployer (creator has 4 launches, dev X account 13) who has already sold out
The same brand died at least 3 times before; this is a relaunch
Volume is far out of proportion to liquidity and looks driven by bots or wash trading
Parent memes (fone) are past their peak
Top10 holders at 17.9% is moderate, but bundled supply may be spread across many wallets

structured_output.counterargument: Both parent memes have real, recent communities, and ZCAT especially has news coverage and a strong following. A self-aware crossover can sometimes catch a second wave if fone or ZCAT holders adopt it. The token has migrated, LP is burned, mint and freeze authority are renounced, about 1,500 holders showed up in 40 minutes, and 7 smart wallets are in it. The CTO flag could mean a community picked it up after the dev left, which can support a longer run past the first hour.
unknowns: Contents of private Telegram call groups and paid KOL pushes
Whether the fone or ZCAT communities or accounts have acknowledged it
Exact bundler supply share currently held
Whether the Aug 12 X account was renamed (GMGN shows no rename history)

source_coverage.notes: Web search for the CA, name and $APEZCAT returned no third-party posts. The project account and launch tweet were read via the fxtwitter API. News coverage found is only about the parent memes (fone, ZCAT), not APEZCAT. DexScreener API was checked for this mint and an earlier mint.

structured_output.thesis: This is a low-effort crossover of two already-hot memes. It was relaunched by an operator who had already tried the same brand on at least 3 earlier mints that died. The current spike is mainly bundler and bot volume at launch, with almost no visible organic social spread. I expect attention to fade over the next hours.
